notes.subject: יחסדך
notes.rationale: חסד hiphil here means 'put to shame/revile', unlike its usual sense of loyal-love; renderings split between 'shame' and 'defame'.

notes.subject: ritirit
notes.rationale: שוב 'turn back' rendered as Tok Pisin 'ritirit' (withdraw); 'your slander not turning away' = it stays on you permanently.

notes.subject: context
notes.rationale: Verse continues the warning against exposing a secret (סוד) to another — consequence of betrayed confidence.

translation: Bilong man i harim i no putim sem long yu, na tok nogut bilong yu i no ken ritirit.

tokens.gloss: i no putim sem long yu
